faqs.question: What is the scope of MBA?
faqs.answer:
The scope of MBA course is increasing day by day. MBA is one of the big job oriented professional programme and the most one which has been sought by the students. Once you have completed your degree, you have a great job opportunity in the industrial world. You may the manager or executive in term of designation.
The management term is most suited to the managers and that's why it is the way, where you can reach on the top of the height as soon as possible by using your leadership and working proficiency. An MBA professional always plays a vital role in his/her company and this is why he used to keep in touch with the board of directors. No need to specify the companies who recruit the MBA professionals. All sectors including government and public have various industries, companies, institutions or related organizations, come in the job prospective fields for an MBA professional.
Some job profiles are listed here:
Brand Manager
Account Manager
International Business Manager
Marketing Executive
Business Technical Consultant
All the best.

Courses Eligibility
MBA/PGDM Candidate must have passed Bachelor Degree (BA / B.Com/ B.Sc/ BBA / BBM / BCA / BE / B.Tech / B. Pharmacy / Any 3 or 4 year Degree except Oriental Languages). review_summary.college_name: Vijaya P.G. College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: This is the best college of MBA in Ranga Reddy in Telangana.

content.Placements: More than 70% of students get placement in this institute. As per my academic year, the minimum package is 3.1 LPA and the maximum package is 8 LPA. More than 75% of students have done an internship in various companies like Dell, Ashirvad, Infosys, KPMG, etc. Top employers are Wipro, Microsoft, Deloitte, etc. Roles offered are hr admin, marketing manager, and financier.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my institution provides good rules and regulations to follow the institution independently. The canteen and mess of the hostel are good for health. We get prompt medical care from the authorities. Every week, we organise tournaments for physical and mental fitness.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: If you want to study MBA, then our college will be the best college for your career.

content.Placements: Above 75% of students who passed will be placed in this organization. The lowest package is 3.1 LPA, and the highest package is 8 LPA, as per my study year. content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my organization is very good. The organization provides everything for students to feel free to study. Some of our students also play at the district level.
